prompt:
TASK:
Create one production-ready sticker sheet containing exactly 4 game sprites.

PROJECT CONTEXT:
wynlo-landing: Logo marks for the Wynlo personal studio site.

STYLE:
STYLE LOCK: Match the reference image exactly in drawing style. The reference is the Cashmere mark: a person's head and shoulders in three-quarter view, drawn with one very bold black outline, a white face, a solid black hair shape and two short vertical dash eyes.

PRIMARY GOAL: A friendly robot character for a personal software studio. Logo marks must read at favicon size. Scene illustrations show the same robot doing one simple action on a landing page.

CORE AESTHETIC: The same character as the reference mark, but a robot. Replace the hair with a solid black robot part (a visor cap, a rounded helmet top, or an antenna block). Keep the chunky rounded head and the calm, slightly turned pose. Logo marks use bust framing. Scenes show the full robot: the same head and helmet, a small rounded-rectangle body, short tube arms with round mitten hands, and two short stubby legs.

LINE: One very bold, even black outline on every shape, the same weight everywhere. Rounded caps and joins. Smooth geometric curves, no wobble.

FILL: White inside every outline. Exactly one solid black accent shape, like the reference's hair. No grey, no tints, no hatching.

COLOR: Two colours only: black #1A1A1A and white.

FACE: Two short vertical black dash eyes. No mouth, no nose, no other face detail.

DETAIL LEVEL: Very few shapes. A logo mark has at most one small detail and stays clear at 24px. A scene has the robot plus two or three simple props, each large.

COMPOSITION: Logo marks: one mark per cell, centred, wide white margin. Scenes: one robot and its props, centred, wide white margin, no ground texture, no background scenery. No text anywhere.

PALETTE:
White #FFFFFF (background), Ink #1A1A1A (outline), Ink Fill #1A1A1A (fill)

SHAPE LANGUAGE:
chunky rounded head shapes, soft rounded-rectangle forms, one solid black accent shape, like the Cashmere mark's hair, two short vertical dash eyes, three-quarter head and shoulders bust

RENDERING RULES:
- match the reference mark's line weight, fill and simplicity exactly
- very bold even black outline with rounded caps and joins
- white fills, one solid black accent shape per mark
- eyes are two short vertical black dashes, nothing else on the face
- no grey, no shading, no gradients
- reads as a clear silhouette at 24px
- absolutely no text, letters or symbols
- crisp high-resolution raster

CATEGORY:
Potatoheads studio logo marks: a potato head only, no body, no neck, no arms, front or slightly turned view

EXACT ASSETS:
1. an irregular lumpy potato head with a small solid black two-leaf sprout on top
2. a rounded bean-shaped potato head tilted slightly, with a solid black sprout curling from the top
3. a lumpy potato head with two small eye-bud dimples on the skin and a solid black leaf sprout
4. a wide oval potato head with a solid black patch of soil on its top like hair and one tiny sprout

CANVAS AND LAYOUT:
Output size 1024x1024. Solid flat background #FFFFFF with no texture, no vignette, no border. Nothing in the picture may use a colour close to the background colour.
Arrange the assets in a neat grid in reading order (left to right, then top to bottom), one asset per cell.
Keep every asset isolated.
Do not let assets touch or overlap.
Use front-facing views only.
Leave generous crop-safe spacing around every asset, at least one asset-width apart.
No labels, text, numbers, scene, ground line, or decorative filler.

SPRITE RULES:
Use strong, rounded silhouettes that remain readable at 24x24px.
Use no more than 2 base colours per asset, plus their shading tones.
No shading. White fills inside bold black outlines, with one solid black accent shape.
Avoid tiny details, intricate textures, and visual clutter.
Use #1A1A1A outlines, very bold even stroke, about 7% of the mark's width, with rounded caps and joins.
Keep the palette, outline weight, proportions, and detail level consistent across the whole sheet.
Draw every asset at a similar visual scale.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
text, letters, numbers, watermark, colour of any kind, grey fills, gradients, drop shadows, glow, 3D render, metallic shine, rivets and bolts clutter, thin hairlines, sketchy lines, mouths, noses, eye whites, glowing eyes, circle badge frames

FINAL CHECK:
Exactly 4 assets.
Every requested asset is present once, in the listed order.
Every asset is separate, readable, and crop-safe.

ADDITIONAL DETAILS:
This is not a robot. Draw a potato character head in the exact line style of the references: one very bold even black outline, white fill, two short vertical dash eyes, no mouth, no nose. The potato outline is lumpy and organic but still smooth and confident. The only solid black shape is the sprout or soil accent. Each mark reads as a clear silhouette at 17px.
